blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag confirmed on Tuesday that the bureau had raided houses supposedly owned by former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco and his wife, Rowena, in August. Matibag said during an interview that the NBI conducted the raid on Aug. 24 after receiving intelligence information about supposed illegal high-powered firearms in some houses in Valle Verde in Pasig City. “We applied for a search warrant. We searched for it, and it turned out that the houses named after other personalities were actually owned by the former speaker and Ms. Rowena, based on their […]...
